name: Worker
description: The compas_acoustics worker, the Python that runs every simulation and analysis: its state, its Python, its version and whether its schema matches this plugin. Restart stops and starts it; Open log opens what it printed.

outputParameters.name: python
outputParameters.description: The worker's Python interpreter; empty when the installer has not run.

outputParameters.name: version
outputParameters.description: The compas_acoustics version the running worker has; empty when it does not run.
